summary: Race-mode screen parameter initializer: stores the RaceMode value dword_7D0410 into this at offset 0x324 and the address of the parameter float flt_7D122C into this at offset 0x320, then formats a display string and pushes it into the edit buffer. When flt_7D122C is 0.0 it formats the first UI list item (index 0) instead; otherwise it formats the float itself with the "%.1f" format string. Always returns 0.

local_names.v2: UI list item text pointer fetched from index 0 when the parameter float is zero
local_names.v4: 32-byte local string buffer holding the formatted display text

operations.description: Store (float)dword_7D0410 into this at offset 0x324 (byte 804, dword index 201).
Store the address of flt_7D122C into this at offset 0x320 (byte 800, dword index 200).
Branch on whether the parameter float flt_7D122C equals 0.0: zero selects the UI-list formatting path, non-zero selects the float-formatting path.
Zero branch: v2 = UIListIndexedAccessor(this, 0); fetch the UI list item at index 0.
Zero branch: StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck(v4, v2); format the UI list item text into the local buffer.
Non-zero branch: StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck(v4, "%.1f", flt_7D122C); format the float value using the "%.1f" format string (the packet labels global a1f at 0x005C6E50 as this format string).
EditBufferStringUpdate(this, v4); push the formatted display text into the edit buffer.
